purpose: This document explains the purpose of Confirm Booking Request function.
features: The “Confirm Request” option in DCSA Booking Activity (UC5: Confirm Booking Request) allows the agency user to manually select and confirm a booking request. Ideally, confirmation is triggered automatically when the booking confirmation is sent from the system. Because some Yang Ming agents do not process booking confirmations from AFSYS+, a manual option is provided.
The agency user can confirm the request only if a booking has been generated against it.
•	The booking request must be converted into a Yang Ming actual booking.
•	The actual booking must not be in PRE-ENTERED status.
•	The actual booking must not be in CANCELLED or FREEZE status.
When the user confirms the booking request, the system calls HQ Temp 2 Processing and the HQ Track & Trace Event Log. The booking request moves to CONFIRMED state.
•	The Carrier confirms the booking request and updates its state to CONFIRMED.
•	The Carrier sends a notification to the relevant registered counterparts with the Carrier Booking request reference, the Carrier Booking reference and the state of the booking.
When the agency user manually confirms a booking request, the system calls the HQ Temp 2 processing procedure.

All booking information is passed to the HQ procedure in a PL/SQL table that follows the HQ Temp 2 table format. Several of the required columns are not available in AFSYS+, so the missing data is taken from the Temp 3 intermediate process. The latest data available in AFSYS+ is used first, and the remaining data comes from Temp 3. Once the PL/SQL table is populated, the HQ procedure is called.
•	P_AMS_DETAILS – not available in Temp 3; passed as a NULL record.
•	P_CUS_REF_DETAILS – intermediate process, otherwise a NULL record.
When the agency user manually confirms a DCSA booking request, the system calls the HQ Track & Trace event log procedure to record the confirmation event.
•	P_DATA_SOURCE = DCSA, P_DATA_TYPE = OUT, P_DOC_TYPE = BK
•	P_CONTRACT_REF = Trade ID (Case ID) if available
•	P_DOC_REF_DETAILS = Type CBR, Value: Carrier booking request number
